name: Shopping Cart Icon
description: Icon for shopping cart and add to cart actions

variations.name: default
variations.description: Item falls into cart from above and cart shakes when adding to cart

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of the icon in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Stroke color of the icon (CSS color value)

props.name: isAdding
props.description: Triggers the add to cart animation. Set to true when item is being added to cart.
